description: Makes one design per row of a table — a card for every speaker, a price tag for every product — each row in a copy of the sample artboard (the person’s design, or a new one from a brief), all in one file. Row keys are roles (headline, date, person, price…) or the sample’s slot names. Use it when the person has a list or a sheet. Free plan: 10 rows at a time. Example: { brief: «speaker cards for our meetup», rows: [{ person: «Anna Koval», title: «Design lead» }, …] }. Counts as one design.

brief.description: with no design: what the sample is for; e.g. «speaker cards for our meetup»

design.description: a sample design (its first artboard, or `artboard`); none: a new one from brief

format.description: with brief: the sample’s format (none: read from the brief)

rows.description: one object per design, keys = roles or the sample’s slot names; e.g. [{ "person": "Ada Lovelace", "date": "Fri 14:00" }]

style.description: with brief: a style in words or a pack id

name: bulk_create
title: Make many from a table
